protocol.ground: shared infinite-enough flat ground; all city and boundary bodies removed
protocol.note: No ESC, no artificial yaw/sideslip forces. Road-wheel step with existing 14/s first-order steering. Peak beta computed from body-frame CG velocity; trace samples 10 Hz. Different runs may decelerate due to tire scrub.

thermo.note: 650 m/s is an effective constant exhaust velocity assumption, not measured Roadster data. The 50 bar isentropic perfectly expanded air value at 293 K is an upper ideal value before nozzle losses; tank cooling further lowers the available exit speed.
